note: Language-independent incident/v1 vectors. invalid_structural is refused by raw schema; invalid_semantic passes raw schema but violates normative admission. proof/containment/selector/coverage/selection/agreement/repetition are context-dependent semantics over claims. Records are claims: no vector establishes reporter truth, actual cause, issuer fence or authority, coordinator policy, enforcement or any recovery effect. No runtime qualification.
